objective: Identify, isolate, and repair a file handle leak in a repository migration utility without mutating existing migration checks.

authorized_context.defect: Database connection or file descriptor opened during migrate_copy is not closed upon exception, causing ResourceWarning and locked files on Windows.
constraints: Zero breaking changes to operations.py API

forbidden_assumptions: Do not assume garbage collector automatically closes SQLite connections deterministically on Windows.
Do not assume suppressing ResourceWarning is an acceptable fix.
Do not alter public function signatures.
source_of_truth: PEP 343 & Python SQLite3 Connection Management Invariants.
